## Summary

A send-keys control message beside copy-buffer in terminal-ws.ts. Every constant comes from assets/workshops/001-send-keys-to-coding-agents.md and from nowhere else — NOT from a grep of the pij repo, whose CLI carries a stale harness-blind 300ms (pij#159).

(1) ONE exported table carrying ermine's measured values (claude/codex/pi 350, copilot 900) — pij drifted precisely here, daemon 350/900 vs CLI hardcoded 300 (pij#159), so a second numeric settle literal anywhere in the feature is the defect. (2) SELECT THE MAXIMUM UNCONDITIONALLY. The server has no harness signal — grep terminal-ws.ts for harness / pane_current_command / display-message returns nothing — and building a detector would create an instrument whose failure mode is the SHORT settle, i.e. the stranded-composer bug, invisible in testing. Keep the table as documented knowledge; do not key on it yet. (3) The wait must not block the socket.
